earnings.title: Public Affairs Department
highlights: PACCAR achieved net income of $847.5 million ($1.61 per diluted share) in the third quarter of this year, compared to $590.0 million ($1.12 per diluted share) earned in the same period last year.

PACCAR’s net income in the first nine months of 2026 was $2.20 billion ($4.18 per diluted share) compared to $1.82 billion ($3.45 per diluted share) in the first nine months of 2025, which included a $264.5 million after-tax non-recurring charge related to civil litigation in Europe.
Net sales and financial services revenues for the first nine months of 2026 were $22.26 billion, compared to $21.62 billion in the same period last year.
Consolidated net sales and revenues of $7.94 billion.

quotes.text: PACCAR achieved excellent results in the third quarter of 2026. Revenues increased by 19% and net income increased by 44% compared to same period last year.
Kenworth and Peterbilt’s customers are beginning to refresh their fleets with newer, more fuel efficient trucks.
quotes.by: John Rich, PACCAR executive vice president and chief technology officer
